description: Replaces the prose-dependent CLAUDE.md-to-AGENTS.md pointer signature with an explicit versioned marker. A project can keep a compact, project-owned Claude entry point while the upgrader still verifies that AGENTS.md holds every shared capability marker and CLAUDE.md holds none. Existing legacy pointers remain recognized so the contract is backward-compatible.
delta: The Meridian upgrader recognizes exactly one <!-- MERIDIAN:CLAUDE-AGENTS-POINTER v1 --> marker as an explicit CLAUDE.md pointer. It retains the prior four-phrase prose signature as a legacy fallback. Both forms are rejected if CLAUDE.md carries capability markers; pointer verification still requires AGENTS.md to match every shared marker in the current CLAUDE.md template.
verification: A CLAUDE.md with exactly one MERIDIAN:CLAUDE-AGENTS-POINTER v1 marker and no capability markers is preserved by meridian upgrade when AGENTS.md contains every shared marker
Legacy prose-based CLAUDE.md pointers remain preserved by meridian upgrade
A duplicate explicit pointer marker or any capability marker in CLAUDE.md prevents pointer recognition
